reviews.title: Excellent budget power supply
reviews.comment: I've now used this power supply in three different builds, all three with Ryzen 5 3600s and a mix of video card ranging from a gtx 1660 super to a vega 56 and this power supply has had no issue keeping up. While it's not modular the flat ribbon cables make cable management really easy and make tucking the cables behind the motherboard tray a easy chore. Noise level is also great you can hardly hear the fan running.
reviews.author: Alberto Garcia

reviews.title: Great supply for the money
reviews.comment: I like Silverstone products and this P/S did not disappoint. Honestly Molex connectors are a thing of the past now and instead of wasting space with molex cables I would suggest adding 1 or 2 sata power to molex adapters instead. Had no issues with this power supply, very clean power delivery.
reviews.author: Sickone

reviews.title: Quality for the price
reviews.comment: I bought this during the great pc part drought of 2020. I got a quality bronze rated psu with no ketchup & mustard cables for 55$. Comes with a warranty in box and was an immediate upgrade from my evga non rated 550w psu. I honestly have no complaints.
reviews.author: Joshua W.

reviews.title: Buena fuente y potencia
reviews.comment: Hasta el momento a funcionado bien y no se ha apagado, aun cuando le tengo conectada una board con Ryzen 5, lectora y quemadora de DVD y varios discos duros y ventiladores con luces LED decorativas, me ha gustado.
reviews.author: Joaquin Cano

reviews.title: can't really review
reviews.comment: The cords are a little short but besides that i can't really say much, the motherboard i used it on was bad so i couldn't get it to boot up to really test the product.
